posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Xtreme Captain Cosmic is awesome, though! Granted, this comes from someone who really doesn't like playing standard CC, but it's so great to be able to put Constructs out and immediately get use from them. If you have an Autonomous Blade, put it on yourself and pile on the damage! Do ludicrous things with even a +1! Or, if you're really struggling to keep Constructs in play for a round, set out a Dynamic Siphon on someone and activate it a couple times with your power! :)

I'm really passionate about the possibilities because this is one of the two foil-release variants that's turned a hero from least to most favorite for me. (The other is Visionary Unleashed.)

posts.name: Kratos13
posts.cooked: The wording I see on the wiki is "; whenever Haka is dealt damage, he regains 1 HP".  So why would this not work with Enduring Intercession?
posts.raw: The wording I see on the wiki is "; whenever Haka is dealt damage, he regains 1 HP".  So why would this not work with Enduring Intercession?

posts.name: bobbertoriley
posts.cooked:
The discrepency is because the foil card says "Whenever he takes damage this way", meaning that it has to be from damage redirection caused by the power and not by Enduring Intercession.

 

(The art on the wiki uses images from the proofs playtesters got, and a few corrections were made to cards like X-Treme Haka before they went to the printer.)
